question: Toon dat $(1 + x^m + x^{-n})^2 - (1 - x^m - x^{-n})^2$ deelbaar is deur $2$ vir alle reële waardes van $m$ en $n$.
memo:
$$\begin{aligned} &(1 + x^m + x^{-n})^2 - (1 - x^m - x^{-n})^2 \\ &= \left[ 1 + x^m + x^{-n} - (1 - x^m - x^{-n}) \right] \left[ 1 + x^m + x^{-n} + (1 - x^m - x^{-n}) \right] \\ &= (2)\left(2x^m + 2x^{-n}\right) \\ &= 4\left(x^m + x^{-n}\right) = 2 \cdot 2\left(x^m + x^{-n}\right) \end{aligned}$$ * $\checkmark$ factorisation
* $\checkmark$ $2$
* $\checkmark$ $(2x^m + 2x^{-n})$
